desc: Derive the BFS-layer characterization: forbidden edges between nonconsecutive layers, arbitrary internal edges, and nonempty predecessor neighborhoods for every root/non-root layer vertex.
Derive the fixed-layer-sequence edge generating polynomial and multinomial label weight.
Develop an efficient DP over positive layer sizes enforcing balanced even/odd layer totals.
Optimize polynomial transitions and precompute factors modulo \(P\) for \(N\le30\).
Validate the implementation on the public samples and relevant edge cases.
